text: They attack enemies with venomous daggers and excellent armor.
These witch-elves, favored by Khaine, have gained even greater power—each strike restores their own wounds.
They are Daughters of Khaine who revel in bloodshed.
Blood Sisters are accustomed to stalking behind the enemy, slowly tormenting their prey with daggers.
A murderous fiend created by Morathi, lurking within the shadows.
A handmaiden created by Morathi through dark magic, skilled in ranged attacks with magic and melee combat with a spear.
A shadowy guard mounted upon winged steeds.
Servants of the Shadow's daughter, chosen by the Cult of Pleasure and trained by the Shadow's daughter herself.
Khaine's executioners, dedicated to carrying out assassinations—they can hurl massive throwing discs as well as fight with masterful melee finesse.
